limits: Historical validators are never executed. Only fixed read-only check/selftest commands and this runner's own .scratch falsification fixtures run; no command is executed from an evidence file.

Filed rounds 8-15 are compared with the declared baseline; any non-append-only byte change or churn during validation fails closed. A NEW keyed packet build may be added; filed bytes are never rewritten.

Claim C is a coverage/staleness map: statuses are receipts that a re-check or correction happened, with the cited evidence. The freshness axis-move remains paused (LOG.md pause record); no source freshness verdict, re-grade, or rank change is issued or implied.

The §3.2.4 census judges surfacing of delivered D3 record ids on the packet text: a record counts as surfaced when it appears in a claim link, an edge target, an edge source, or as an edge row id (the review-9 precedent that a record carried as its own edge row is not orphaned). The rule was calibrated to reproduce review-9.md F9-2's orphan list exactly on packet-v2-05.md; the §3.2.4 letter count (claim link or edge target only) is recorded alongside. The census does not judge whether a link's target record is semantically apt. D2 surfaced records are pinned by the artifact_manifest record_ids column plus packet_links' own E-TARGET-UNKNOWN checks, not re-censused here.
Selftest growth is judged against the round-15 stamped inventory (19/19, 31/31 in review-10.md §F10-2): the link judge must grow; the uncertainty judge must stay green and not shrink.
